App Upgrade
assist-america.description:
Since 1990, Assist America has been committed to providing quality travel assistance services. With our new, optimized mobile app, members can now utilize a wide range of global travel assistance services right from their mobile device, 24/7, anywhere in the world. Enter your reference number and be immediately connected to a wide range of services designed to help you travel confidently.

Features include:

- Tap-for-Help button to call our 24/7 Operations Center
- AssistAlerts: updates on emergent global situations that may impact travel
- Coverage indicator to let members know when they are eligible for services
- Detailed, location-specific information through our pre-trip tab
- Ability to locate nearest embassy and consulate in 23 countries
- Electronic copies of your ID card easily accessible in the app
- Available in English, Spanish, Arabic, Mandarin, Thai, Bahasa, and French

international-sos.releaseNotes: New Check-in Home Screen Widget and performance improvements
international-sos.description:
Stay Safe, Informed and Prepared—Wherever You Travel
 
Make the most of your International SOS subscription with the enhanced Assistance App. Whether you're planning a trip or navigating an emergency abroad, the app provides everything you need to travel confidently and stay protected.
 
Before You Go
Personalized Pre-Trip Checklists: Tailored to your destination and travel profile.
Trusted Medical & Security Advice: From our global network of experts.
Vaccination & Health Info: Understand what’s required before departure and what to expect on arrival.
Visa & Travel Requirements: Find entry rules, visa needs, and travel documentation based on your passport and trip details.
 
While You Travel
24/7 Expert Support: Instantly connect with our team of 12,000 health, security, and logistics professionals—anytime, anywhere.
Crisis Guidance: Know what to do in emergencies, from natural disasters to political unrest.
Find a Doctor: Locate trusted medical professionals near you, wherever you are in the world.
Mental Health Support: Access confidential mental health resources and speak with trained professionals to support your wellbeing while traveling.
 
Even When You're Not Traveling
Destination Research: Explore travel conditions and insights for future trips.
Local Alerts: Stay informed about developing situations in your home location.
 
New & Improved Features
New map view:  easily search for a country, city or destination guide.
One click:  to check in, add a trip or call for assistance.
Trip Management: Organize your itineraries and reservations in one place.
Push Notifications: Receive location-based alerts during emergencies.
Multilingual Support: Available in English, French, German, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Italian, and Spanish.

allyz.description:
Travel Confidently. Allyz® gets you immediate access to the information you need while you’re traveling. Download the app before your next trip to get real-time alerts and updates, easily connect to our 24/7 global assistance line, and find important information regarding your plan.

- Instantly view your plan details in the palm of your hand.
- Book a non-emergency medical appointment, online or in person, with the Global Doctor Visits tool.
- Connect to our 24/7 customer support for help with medical and other travel-related emergencies.
- Find local assistance fast in an emergency.
- File a claim and upload images from your phone for supporting documentation, plus see up to date status.
- Stay organized with real-time flight updates and boarding gate information.
- Instantly generate a letter providing proof of medical or rental car coverage and get a copy sent to your email.
 
No purchase necessary to download the app. Your use of the Allyz® app and any and all content thereon is at all times subject to the Terms of Use. Please note that your mobile device must be compatible with international networks to use certain features overseas, such as calls to 24-Hour Hotline Assistance. Message, data and roaming rates and charges may apply to your use of the app and content thereon and be charged by your mobile carrier or other service provider. This application is not a substitute for medical advice or treatment. All plans/claims subject to policy terms, conditions, and exclusions.
 
AWP USA Inc. and its affiliates, including Jefferson Insurance Company and AGA Service Company d/b/a Allianz Global Assistance, are committed to protecting your privacy. By using the Allyz® app, including any content thereon, you are consenting to the collection and processing of your personal data under as described in our Privacy Policy.

adac-pannenhilfe.description:
Die ADAC Pannenhilfe App bietet Ihnen schnelle und intuitive Hilfe bei der Unfall- oder Pannenmeldung an den ADAC weltweit. Sie ist leicht zu bedienen und immer einsatzbereit.

Um in einem Notfall Zeit zu ersparen, können Sie Ihr Profil und Ihre Fahrzeuge schon vorab in der App anlegen und/oder durch Anmelden (Login) auf adac.de Ihre Daten synchronisieren lassen.

Dank der Ortungsfunktion lokalisiert die ADAC Pannenhilfe App Ihren Pannenort automatisch. Im Ernstfall lassen sich so alle wichtigen Informationen schnell und unkompliziert an unsere Helfer übermitteln. Nach erfolgter Hilfeanforderung werden Sie durchgehend per Push- und Statusmeldungen über den aktuellen Auftragsstatus auf dem Laufenden gehalten. Außerdem wird Ihnen die voraussichtliche Wartezeit mitgeteilt und Sie haben die Möglichkeit den Standort des Fahrers kurz vor dem Eintreffen live zu verfolgen.

Die Pannenhilfe App steht allen Nutzern im vollen Umfang kostenlos zur Verfügung – auch Nichtmitgliedern. Die Hilfeleistungen durch die ADAC Pannenhilfe sind jedoch nur für Mitglieder im Rahmen der Mitgliedschaftsbedingungen kostenfrei.

Das bietet die ADAC Pannenhilfe App:

•	Schnelle Hilfe bei Panne und Unfall weltweit
•	Unkomplizierte Pannenmeldung ohne Telefonanruf 
•	Pannenhilfe für Auto, Motorrad und Fahrrad
•	Weltweite Standortbestimmung
•	Status Aktualisierungen inkl. Live-Tracking
•	Soforthilfe oder Terminwunsch
•	Automatische Spracherkennung Deutsch / Englisch
•	Digitale Mitgliedskarte immer abrufbereit
•	Barrierefrei für Menschen mit Beeinträchtigungen
•	Unfallcheckliste

green-flag.releaseNotes: We’ve tidied a few things up behind the scenes to make sure the app runs as smoothly as ever.
green-flag.description:
The Green Flag app makes breakdowns a little less stressful. Because unless you can fit a technician in your glovebox, having this on your phone is the next best thing.

If you’ve broken down, getting help is easy.

Tap your location on the map, tell us a few details about what’s happened, and your technician will be on the way.

You can even live-track your technician’s location as they drive to you, for extra peace of mind.

Request -> Track -> Rescue. All in a few taps.

Oh, a quick note about how we use data on this App.

When you use our App, you’ll be sharing some data with us. This includes your location (which helps us find you if you break down), contact info and your Green Flag Account details. You can find out more in that handy ‘App Privacy’ section below.

We also collect data that shows how you use our app. That way, we can plan new features and make improvements based on what you really need.

Rest assured, we never share the data we collect with anyone else.

If you’re not happy with the above, you can always call us instead of using the App if you break down.
